product_one_liner.value: Axure RP helps non-programmers create interactive prototypes with documentation so product and design teams can test solutions, gather feedback, and align development.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 17 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band.

eng_blog.notes: The index is mainly product updates, UX tips, and user stories. The older development-process posts do not establish two clearly technical, engineer-authored posts meeting the stated threshold.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Senior Software Engineer role, not a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Axure’s public product docs, AI/MCP docs, security materials, blog, and subprocessor list reviewed here do not identify a model provider used by the product.

last_funding.notes: A funding profile classifies the reported $350,000 2020 financing as PPP debt; some other company trackers show no known external or venture funding, so this reflects the reported debt record rather than an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported latest financing was a 2020 PPP debt record, outside the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed opening is Senior Software Engineer; no SDR, BDR, or account executive role is shown.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 24, 2026 release introduced Axure RP MCP, Windows Snap flyout support, and faster Mac rendering.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small org listing names President Victor Hsu and CTO Martin Smith; their profiles place them at Axure in 2002. No C-level/VP appointment or departure within the requested window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics and Mailchimp for email marketing.
